description: This file defines a singleton object ApiClient that provides factory methods to create various API service instances such as ProductApi, OrderApi, CartApi, and NotificationApi. It encapsulates Retrofit client setup with Moshi for JSON conversion and OkHttp for HTTP configuration, including logging and timeout settings.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A singleton object providing factory methods for creating API service interfaces with configured Retrofit instances.

methods.name: createRetrofit
methods.description: Constructs and configures a Retrofit instance with the specified base URL, including Moshi converter and OkHttp client with logging and timeout settings.

methods.name: createProductApi
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of ProductApi using Retrofit with the default or provided base URL.

methods.name: createOrderApi
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of OrderApi using Retrofit with the default or provided base URL.

methods.name: createCartApi
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of CartApi using Retrofit with the default or provided base URL.

methods.name: createNotificationApi
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of NotificationApi using Retrofit with the default or provided base URL.
